verdict.rationale: The only probe of this product's robots.txt, on the bizfile filing portal, returned HTTP 200 but served an Incapsula bot-management SPA shell with no robots directives. That means there is no real crawl policy an agent can read there, and no evidence shows a valid robots.txt on www.sos.ca.gov. The Franchise Tax Board probe covers a different agency's host and was not credited.
